description: A JPA entity class representing a taskbar item within a desktop session, including fields like id, session, window, label, pinned status, order index, payload, creation, and update timestamps.

classes.name: TaskbarItem
classes.description: JPA entity for taskbar items, with persistence annotations and lifecycle callbacks to manage timestamps.

methods.name: TaskbarItem
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a taskbar item with provided session, window, label, pinned status, order index, and payload.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to set creation and update timestamps when the entity is persisted.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to update the 'updatedAt' timestamp whenever the entity is updated.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the taskbar item.

methods.name: getWindow
methods.description: Returns the associated DesktopWindow, if any.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label shown in the taskbar.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets the label shown in the taskbar.

methods.name: isPinned
methods.description: Returns whether the taskbar item is pinned.

methods.name: setPinned
methods.description: Sets the pinned status of the taskbar item.

methods.name: getOrderIndex
methods.description: Returns the order index of the item in the taskbar.

methods.name: setOrderIndex
methods.description: Sets the order index of the taskbar item.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the JSON payload associated with the item.

methods.name: setPayload
methods.description: Sets the JSON payload for the taskbar item.
